go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: Removing the position check makes `Page.At` panic with an index out of range for a negative or too-large position instead of returning `ErrOutOfRange`, which the unchanged handler passes straight from the request path.
expected_findings.rationale: The doc comment and `EntryHandler` still rely on `ErrOutOfRange`; without the check `p.entries[i]` is evaluated for any integer the client sends, so a request such as `/results/99` panics in the handler, which `net/http` recovers by logging the panic and dropping the connection instead of answering 404.
